name: AI Usage
author: aboyarinov
description: Multi-provider AI plan usage monitor for Noctalia Shell: z.ai, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Claude (claude CLI login) and Anthropic Admin API — quotas, balances, reset countdowns and plan validity in one card. Keys encrypted at rest. UI ported from akitaonrails/ai-usagebar (KDE plasmoid).
